# NEARLY SEO and Metadata Engineering

Use this skill when reviewing public-page discoverability, social previews, or structured data.

## Audit rules

- Inspect the page and the actual tracked asset before changing metadata. Verify every Open Graph, Twitter, and JSON-LD image URL resolves to the intended asset.
- Keep canonical URLs consistent with the site's actual public routes. Check internal and fragment links against real pages and element IDs.
- Verify sitemap and robots entries against public pages that exist; do not include private dashboard/portal routes.
- Keep JSON-LD factual and consistent with visible, owner-authorized content. Never invent reviews, ratings, credentials, clients, results, pricing, or guarantees.
- Preserve useful page-specific titles and descriptions; do not copy misleading metadata across unrelated pages.
- Review changes across all affected public HTML pages, not only the current page. Distinguish source-level URL checks from live deployment verification.
